About The Sham Sharma Show 

The Sham Sharma is dedicated to raising a voice for India's indigenous culture. This channel looks at politics, culture, and pop culture and tries to make sense of things, past the bias and misinformation. The channel strives to debunk bias against India's native culture and campaign that all cultures and ideas be studied dispassionately and judged on their merits, history, and actions.
So if you want India to be represented fairly, but also have some fun and enjoy some memes along the way, SUBSCRIBE NOW!

comments.text: In today’s information age, strong national media voices are essential for every country. Just as the Middle East has influential networks like Al Jazeera and China has globally recognized outlets shaping its economic and strategic narrative, India too needs confident Indian media that can present its perspective to the world. During moments like Operation Sindoor, misinformation spread rapidly online — including false claims about Indian ports being destroyed — showing how important it is to counter fake narratives with credible, timely reporting. A media platform rooted in India’s civilizational identity, including values associated with Hindutva, yoga, and dharmic traditions, can help communicate India’s cultural and strategic viewpoint more effectively. That’s why it’s inspiring to see a YouTuber launching an English-language channel dedicated to this mission: it has the potential to strengthen India’s voice globally and contribute positively to the ongoing “narrative war” in the digital era.

transcript: No. No. Don't worry. This is not such a dangerous thing. Look, I wanted to talk to you about how over the last few years, we haven't just created a YouTube channel. We have hopefully developed an entire ecosystem. A growing community that is unapologetic about Indian culture and does not allow outsiders to define its history. She takes charge of it herself and is ready to fiercely defend her religion and her narrative. This community is becoming stronger year after year. And hopefully along the way we have some fun too. And in 2026 I was thinking that now we need to plan ahead. It's time to elevate and broaden our content. It's time to reach a larger audience and introduce new people to your world view. As India is becoming stronger and prosperous. I think it's important that India's point of view can be provided not only to Indians but to the entire world through an authentic lens. Through people who do not hate India, who love India, who have a natural strong belief in India. And so starting this year I want to seriously focus on English language content along with our Hindi language content. This English language content is for Indians but not just for the Indian audience; it will be designed to resonate with a global audience as well so that the whole world can hear our message directly from us. Not from the New York Times, not from the Washington Post, not from The Wire [music], not from The Print. We want the world to understand India's point of view properly by hearing it directly in their language. And another thing that I deeply believe in and want to incorporate in my show is that I think Hindutva and martial arts should be completely intertwined with each other. Hindutva and martial arts should be inseparable. In fact, Hindutva should become a synonym for martial arts. I practice martial arts and I want to hopefully inspire more people through my channel and my examples to pick up martial arts, join martial arts because I think it's very important that every Indian should learn martial arts. I want to develop more vlogs and content around martial arts so that younger people who believe in Hindutva ideology or are pro-India in general get inspired towards martial arts. It was also Veer Savarkar 's dream that every able bodied Indian should be proficient in martial arts and be able to defend himself and this will not only create a physically strong India but also a spiritually strong India and to make this dream of Veer Savarkar come true, my plan is that when I come to India, I am also thinking of creating some documentaries connecting the history of Hindutva and Indian martial arts. We also have big plans to create some products. We are going to launch products that will help spread our message. Particularly for young audiences and help them connect more strongly with their culture. This is hopefully a big hint of what is coming your way in the future. And that is why I want to talk to you today about YouTube memberships. Because today formally through this video we are launching YouTube Memberships on Shyam Sharma Show. Because look, initially we had launched memberships on Patreon. But for me personally, it was becoming very difficult for me to manage the community on Paton. Honestly, very frankly, I was not able to manage my community properly on Patreon at all. But what I've noticed is that YouTube memberships provide a very easy way for us to connect with our community. I want us to not only connect better with each other but also harness the creativity of the community to grow our show. We get a lot of suggestions through emails and in the comments and I want us to brainstorm new ideas together on how we can improve , grow and bring this show to a new audience. And see, YouTube memberships will give us a lot of help in fulfilling all the plans that I have told you. And so whoever you are can directly become a part of the future of Shyam Sharma Show. And another thing that memberships help us with is that they protect us from erratic YouTube policies. Sometimes YouTube likes our content, sometimes it does n't. All videos get monetized within a month. Then suddenly, for three to four weeks, 50 to 60% of our videos get demonetized. Yes, they get demonetized eventually after the review but by then we lose a lot of revenue. This happened to us very recently in the recent video we released of Himata Vishwa Sharma. Just because we discussed what action Himanta is going to take against illegal Bangladesh. So I hope you will join our membership plans. And I wanted to make such plans that we can deliver something regularly, routinely and properly to you also. So our first perk is Rishi Perk which is ₹499 or around ₹480 per month. In this you will get loyalty badges and emojis which you can see on this screen which will become more premium with time. So the longer you have been a member, the more premium loyalty badges you will get. These badges and emojis will appear in live chat and comments. Whenever you leave a comment either in the comments or in the live chat. You will get exclusive early access to all our English videos and many more Hindi videos completely ad free. And we will give priority reply to our members. Their live stream questions will receive priority answers and our members will also receive discounts on any future products we develop. On top of that, we are also putting out members-only polls. That means you, our members, will directly decide which videos we should make. We will give you video topics and you can vote on those topics and you can directly contact Shyam Sharma Show. We have a second tier which is our dev tier. ₹999 per month or ₹950 per month. In this, you will get access to members-only custom Discord servers. The advantage of this is, as I was saying, I want to harness the creativity and power of the community to grow our show. So in that we can all instagram ideas. You can connect with other members. We Can Create a Busling Community There. For the Tuesday Meme Review, you can share memes on Discord and we will play your memes directly on our Meme Review. Along with that, you will also get behind the scenes videos on how we do research, how the recording happens and you will also get some bonus content on my martial arts journey. And along with that, you also get all the perks that are on the Rishi tier [music]. And then we come to our final tier which is Shakti tier which is $1999 or ₹150 per month. I am genuinely very excited for this. Because here we will conduct monthly brainstorming sessions directly with the members. Where you can ask me anything. We can talk about the show. Here you can help us shape our English and Hindi content. And yes, if you are interested in martial arts like I am, you can ask me anything about Judo and BJ. I will be more than happy to answer your questions. And I will be more than happy to show you and encourage you and guide you on how to approach martial arts, be it BJ or Judo, how to join it, how to develop it and I want to add one more important thing here that our regular podcasts, our regular videos, all of these will always remain free. There will never be any paywall issue in this. If you do not want to take membership, then there is no problem, you will be able to watch all our free content for free forever. We love you whether or not you become a member. See, our goal has always been to include as many people as possible in our world view, to take India's point of view to the world and I think that through this membership system, we will get these resources. We will be able to attack this goal properly. We will grow our show. We will develop our English content. To reach a new audience. We will engage with our awesome community in a better and meaningful way. And genuinely take our message globally.
